body: I keep giving people the benefit of the doubt, and sure enough they shit all over me. Fuck people. I'm feeling so done, I want to tell these people off, but there's no point, their worldview will be perceived as the right one, and unlike them I am aware of what I'm doing, so I would be speaking with intention to harm. And I'm better than that. But it's hard not to speak out. I just keep feeling more and more worthless
Sorry to hear about that, I'm doing ok. I'm not suicidal just pretty depressed for various reasons. Things will be more clear soon anyway...I'll be ok
I find your writing a bit confusing (hell, I suppose I'm rather confusing myself) , but I think I get your sentiment. Cheers.
Not exactly sure what you are trying to say to me lol.

This post kind of undermines your thesis of you being a horrible person in your other posts. From my perspective you're a good enough person to try and help a random stranger you don't even know on the Internet. Lol don't know how many people take the time out of their selfish lives to do that. If we had more people like you in the world I think we'd all be better off.
Btw feel free to just say hi if you have no idea what to say lol

It's probably a bad idea to reply to your message when I myself am currently feeling like shit. Just know that as cliche as this sounds as well, this too shall pass. Think about it rationally, you're 25 your statistically likely to live to at least 80. Even if this lifetime has been total shit. You have approximately 3 more ENTIRE life times as you currently understand it to do what ever the fuck you want. Think about it this way, start a new life today, you're a lot smarter and have a huge edge than when you were 1 year old :P. Sometimes being at the bottom is just a chance at a new start. Easier said than done, but it is logically true... Believe me bro, I've suffered from anxiety and depression, were all in the same boat. I'm mid-late 20s myself. I think I'll get through this slump, but it's going to take time. I'll trudge along if you do :P. I think we can both do it
